minutes.headline: Water Commissioners tabled funding a Keings-Lancaster water main design until state PFAS rules are set.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Water District Commissioners spent most of the meeting weighing whether to pay an engineering firm now to survey and design a transmission main linking the Keings and Lancaster well fields, ahead of unknown state PFAS treatment rules; the board opted to table that spending until the state's regulations are final. The board also discussed a public records request fee, referred a Woodlands zone-one easement/kayak dispute to legal counsel for executive session, and covered routine well operations, a possible well-site purchase, and scheduling.

what_happened.line: Water Commissioners tabled spending on an engineering design for a Keings-to-Lancaster transmission main until state PFAS treatment rules are finalized.
The board referred a Woodlands zone-one easement and kayak-storage dispute to legal counsel, to be taken up in executive session at the next meeting.
Commissioners agreed the Clerk/Treasurer may bill a records requester for staff time spent locating and redacting two years of credit card records.
The board moved its July 22 meeting to July 29 at 4 p.m., with executive session at the end of the agenda rather than the start.
A commissioner was directed to inquire about purchasing land to protect the Goodrich Street well site and report back a cost.

why_it_matters: Delaying the transmission main design means any bond request to voters for that project, and any related water rate impact, stays on hold until the state sets PFAS treatment requirements.
The records-fee decision touches how the district charges residents who request public documents, and the redaction of credit card numbers affects what a requester actually receives.
A future purchase of land near the Goodrich Street well site would be a district expenditure aimed at protecting a water supply source.
watch_next: State DEP/EPA final PFAS treatment regulations, which the board is waiting on before funding the transmission main design
